threatFindings.threat: Shortening the generation period (7-word rebuild, 2 turns less per generation) hurts badly against the strong field (2024 finalists + peers)
threatFindings.evidence: 20261003182735454-A004-screen-ou61i: strong -0.163 [-0.231,-0.095], 0/7 cohorts; this includes sstrong-3, which has only 2024 finalists (-0.14); ALL -0.030 with CI below 0
threatFindings.impact: Rev0's 9-word rebuild (19 turns) should be left alone; the period seems tuned or lucky against the 2024 finalists. Do not 'optimize' the rebuild length

threatFindings.threat: Changing first-generation geometry (equal 400h first trail for A and B) loses against the strong field and multi-copy cohorts
threatFindings.evidence: 20261003182735364-A004-screen-irlaj: strong -0.15 [-0.245,-0.055] 1/6; multi -0.135; lead_V6 -0.17. The 2025 group was +0.014 but not significant
threatFindings.impact: The 100h/600h asymmetry is load-bearing for strong opponents; first-gen gap edits should be single-side and small

threatFindings.threat: Screen harness: is a large strong-group loss just chaos from any timing change?
threatFindings.evidence: One-turn phase probes 20261003183026303-A004-screen-yx4ug (A, ALL +0.001, CI +/-0.0065) and 20261003183026411-A004-screen-ujom1 (B, ALL -0.002) left most cohorts unchanged (many zero diffs) and strong stayed within -0.03. Earlier TEST job: identical binaries give exactly 0
threatFindings.impact: The paired screen is low-noise for small timing edits, so the -0.15 strong losses of C1/C2 are real effects, not reshuffled randomness

recommendation: Do not promote any A004 candidate. C1 (equalized first gen) and C2 (7-word rebuild) are clearly negative on strong (-0.15/-0.16). C3 (A first-copy CX 8) is ALL +0.001 with 2025 +0.010 (CI above 0) but threat -0.010; below the threshold, and at most a low-priority idea to retest. C4 is neutral. Geometry and period parameters of rev0 look locally tuned; future roles should not spend jobs on rebuild-length or first-gap equalization.
